links.comparator_used: Same Llama-3.1-8B without RAG (training knowledge alone); also GPT-4o and Claude Opus without RAG
links.outcome: Share of recommendations rated 'Usually appropriate' per ACR criteria, and run-to-run consistency
links.effect: ped-Llama (RAG) 80% (40/50) 'Usually appropriate' vs Llama-3.1-8B without RAG 46%, GPT-4o 54%, Claude Opus 46%; 90% when 'May be appropriate' also accepted; consistency across runs 72% vs 44-50% for generic LLMs
links.quote: ped-Llama achieved 80% (40/50) "Usually appropriate" recommendations, outperforming Llama-3.1-8B (46%), GPT-4o (54%), and Claude Opus (46%), and matching the specialist radiologist (76%).

design_hint: retrieval-augmented grounding in ACR guidelines with local deployment
